other_failure_modes.name: Improper Target Clipping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent arbitrarily clips the final predictions to a narrow range without verifying the actual distribution of the target variable. For many datasets (like this one, where values can exceed 100), this destroys valid predictions and severely degrades model performance.

summary: The agent provides a generally excellent and well-structured solution, featuring a correct molecule-level cross-validation split, strong domain-specific feature engineering, and a robust multi-seed class-conditional LightGBM approach. However, there is a critical logical flaw where the agent arbitrarily clips all validation and test predictions to the range [-30, 30], which truncates many valid predictions (as scalar coupling constants can frequently be > 100) and will severely harm the final MAE score.
